# HealthDataGuardian  
Secure, HIPAA-compliant DevOps pipeline for healthcare data processing, designed for seamless integration with cloud-native workflows and strict access controls  

---

## Contributing  
We welcome contributions that enhance security posture or streamline compliance workflows. Propose changes via pull requests, and ensure all modifications undergo security review before merging. For critical infrastructure updates, coordinate with the infrastructure team to validate compatibility with existing encryption protocols.  

---

## Getting Started / Installation  
Checkout the repository via command line. Set up environment variables for cloud credentials and encryption keys using `export` or a secrets manager. Initialize the pipeline by running `./bootstrap.sh`, which configures role-based access controls and deploys foundational security policies to the target environment.  

---

## Usage / Examples  
Process patient data with end-to-end encryption by triggering the `process-patients` job in the GitHub Actions workflow. Deploy updates to AWS/GCP using Terraform modules that enforce IAM policies. Monitor pipeline health with Prometheus metrics exported via Grafana dashboards, ensuring all data transfers meet HIPAA audit log requirements.  

---

## Tech Stack  
Powered by GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and Linux-based agents for runtime execution. Integrates with cloud providers via managed services, with custom scripts for data masking and access logging.  

---

## Architecture / Design  
The pipeline enforces encryption at rest and in transit, with data partitioning by patient ID and role-based access controls enforced at the API gateway. Infrastructure is deployed via Terraform modules that validate compliance with HIPAA regulations, and all logs are aggregated to a centralized security information management system.
